methodology: Individual-sense review by the coding assistant (model-assisted semantic curation). Preferences pin one attested dictionary sense for the unchanged normalized TARGET-language raw token, before joining any source-language translation. Missing translations must not fall back to another meaning. Case-insensitive matching preserves Turkish dotted/dotless I and original raw corpus ranks. Exclusions affect only frequency decks, retaining dictionary senses. Inflected tokens are never lemmatized or assigned their unrelated homograph meaning. Native token counts do not supply measured sense frequencies: ordinary teaching-sense preference is an editorial judgement. Coverage records distinguish systematic inventory from individual heading review. This is not native-speaker certification of every translation. Independently reviewed modern editorial core concepts may supersede a recorded missing-sense exclusion.
